name: Ananda Chatbot Development
install: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH" && PYTHON_BIN=$(command -v python3.11 || command -v python3) && "$PYTHON_BIN" -c 'import sys; assert sys.version_info[:2] == (3, 11), "Python 3.11 required"' && (command -v uv >/dev/null || curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh) && uv sync --locked --package mega-rag-chatbot && uv run playwright install && touch .env.ananda && (grep -qxF 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH"' ~/.bashrc || echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH"' >> ~/.bashrc)
